the_finding_this_run_exists_for: Nine of ten completed runs under-forecast revenue, two-sided sign test p=0.0215, mean -0.2995 log across 280 cells and six industries. Substituting the actual exchange rate ALONE takes this run's revenue bias from -0.469 to -0.001. Every origin holds FX at its origin-dated value because that is the only thing knowable there — defensible, and a systematic downward lean in a currency that stepped three times in six years. That is a property of the METHOD and not of Abu Qir, which is why this run earns its place without striking a value.
